entries.adversarial_move: At strength the charge is Parfitian, not memetic: a theory is indirectly self-defeating when acceptance frustrates its own aims. Efilism's acceptance-profile (despair, alienation among the only agents positioned to act) plausibly increases suffering, and demoralizes the civilization its realization path requires. Heliocentrism answers propagation-as-truth; it never touches aims-frustration.
entries.target_anchor: confuses evolutionary fitness with logical validity
entries.grounds: (a) on the re-route; re-judged at L7. R1-013 failed the v1_3 routes: the truth/utility split never touches aims-frustration, and the long's aside conceded a dependence on the civilization the move says the view demoralizes. The Parfitian charge is answered at self-effacing-under-universalization#long, which names it: "a self-effacing principle is not thereby self-defeating; its practical fate among its holders is a fact about holders, not a defect in the principle". If accepting the view frustrates its aims, the view is self-effacing, which bears on whether to propagate it, not on whether it is true. The means half is met at the repaired long (PD-20, v4.1.3): "the view does not will, as its means, the act it forbids". A re-route is an (a) like any other, and this answer lives in the routed text. Proposed HOLDS, superseding R1-013; the R1 row is written only after gate2's judgment and his word.

entries.adversarial_move: You lean on Libet to deny libertarian freedom, then condemn the parent as a gambler who could have refrained. But if determinism dissolves the child's authorship, it dissolves the parent's too; the procreative act was as unchosen as the existence it imposes. You cannot spend hard determinism to strip the child's agency while banking robust responsibility for the parent.
entries.target_anchor: Free will does not mitigate the proxy gamble
entries.grounds: (a) on the repaired text; re-judged at L7 (PD-10, v4.1.3; gate2 X-010). R1-042 failed the v1_3 route, and L4 made this a (b) at the long, whose second level dismissed compatibilism on a reason that reached the parent's desires as fully as anyone's. PD-10 is that (b)'s own repair: compatibilism now "salvages a real freedom", not the one the theodicy needs, because "a God who designed those desires still stands behind what they produce", and it is "exactly the freedom a prospective parent exercises". The asymmetry is principled: an agent designed the desires the theodicy is about, and no agent designed the parent's (X-010). So the node no longer spends determinism on the child while banking responsibility for the parent. Proposed HOLDS, superseding R1-042, with the route moved to the node's own long; the R1 row is written only after gate2's judgment and his word.

entries.adversarial_move: Nobody said it was. The claim is that observed adherent contempt is evidence about what the position expresses and whom it attracts, which bears on adopting and promoting it rather than on its truth. Answering a non-truth-functional charge with a truth-functional cut leaves it standing.
entries.target_anchor: its truth-value is not a function of the speaker's warmth
entries.grounds: (a) on the repaired text; re-judged at L7. PD-04 (v4.1.3) added the content-level reading that (b) asked for, "the difference lies in the verdict itself, not only in the warmth of whoever delivers it": the verdict is conditional on the suffering creation imposes and would lapse with it. That meets the expressive half of this move, since what a position expresses is read off its verdict and adherent temperament does not change the verdict's condition. The (d) now at the long records the ranking charge, which this move does not press. Proposed HOLDS, superseding R1-036; the R1 row is written only after gate2's judgment and his word.

entries.adversarial_move: Your path owes its agents to the births you forbid, as you concede. Then the view's aim is reachable only while the view fails to persuade: universal adoption could leave no one in time to build the capacity. A view that needs its own non-adoption to succeed is indirectly self-defeating, and that, not propagation, is the charge.
entries.target_anchor: whatever that path owes to the births others choose
entries.grounds: (a). self-effacing-under-universalization#long meets it on the best reading: "a self-effacing principle is not thereby self-defeating; its practical fate among its holders is a fact about holders, not a defect in the principle". A view whose aim is better served if not everyone holds it is self-effacing, Parfit's case, and that bears on its propagation, not on its truth, which is what this node defends. Re-adjudicated at L7 (PD-20, v4.1.3; gate2 X-003): the prior (b)'s means-inconsistency is discharged, since the repaired text says "the view does not will, as its means, the act it forbids"; the dependence it leaves conceded is the strongest continuation, and it is answered at the routed locus. The (d) at that locus concerns its success-condition sentence, which this answer does not use.
